overview: The PLI for Solar PV Modules is a Production Linked Incentive scheme aimed at boosting domestic manufacturing of high-efficiency solar photovoltaic modules in India. It supports the national goal of achieving 500 GW of non-fossil fuel-based electricity generation capacity by 2030 and reducing reliance on imports. The scheme provides financial incentives based on incremental sales of domestically manufactured solar PV modules over a five-year period. It is part of broader efforts to strengthen India's solar manufacturing ecosystem under the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative.
objectives: Enhance domestic manufacturing capacity of high-efficiency solar PV modules
Reduce dependence on imported solar PV modules
Achieve 500 GW of non-fossil fuel-based electricity generation capacity by 2030
Support Atmanirbhar Bharat through self-reliance in solar manufacturing
Attract investment in the solar PV manufacturing sector
Create employment opportunities in the renewable energy sector
Promote technological advancement and innovation in solar PV manufacturing
eligibility: Domestic manufacturers of solar PV modules who are registered under the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM) and meet the eligibility criteria as per the PLI scheme guidelines issued by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE). Applicants must have a valid GSTIN, PAN, and be engaged in the manufacturing of solar PV modules in India.
benefits: Financial incentives on incremental sales of domestically manufactured solar PV modules over a five-year period, support for scaling up manufacturing capacity, enhancement of domestic value chain in solar energy, reduction in import bills, and strengthening of India's position in the global solar supply chain.
financial_support: The scheme provides a production-linked incentive based on incremental sales of high-efficiency solar PV modules manufactured in India. The incentive is disbursed annually over five years, calculated as a percentage of net sales revenue from eligible products, subject to a cap on total outlay. The total financial outlay for the scheme is INR 24,000 Crore.
application_process: 1. Eligible manufacturers must register on the ALMM portal. 2. Submit application for PLI scheme through the designated MNRE portal. 3. Provide details of manufacturing capacity, technology, and investment plans. 4. Submit required documents including incorporation certificates, GSTIN, PAN, and bank details. 5. Application is evaluated by the Project Appraisal Committee (PAC). 6. Upon approval, a Letter of Award (LoA) is issued. 7. Incentives are claimed annually based on verified incremental sales. 8. Submission of utilization certificates and audit reports is required for each claim.
required_documents: Details of manufacturing facility and capacity
Audit reports of previous financial years
deadlines: As per scheme guidelines; specific windows are announced by MNRE from time to time.
implementing_agency: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
caveats: Incentives are contingent upon achieving minimum domestic value addition
Only manufacturers listed under ALMM are eligible
Incentive disbursement is subject to annual verification of sales and production
Scheme is subject to mid-term review and possible modification
Benefits are available only for a fixed period of five years from the date of award
